_note: Single source of truth for the project name. Change it with: python scripts/rename.py --name NEWNAME --github OWNER/REPO. 'marketplace' must not contain the word claude. 'legacy' lists earlier names: status, update, install and uninstall find installs made under them and move them to the current name.
